errors.error_description: Used logical AND '&&' between a 1-bit signal and a 4-bit vector (req_write && wmask), collapsing a multi-bit mask into a single boolean.
Connected a 32-bit vector to a 16-bit child module port (.wdata(wdata_reg)) causing a width mismatch at instantiation.
Created an implicit net by assigning to an undeclared wire (phantom_wire), relying on default nettype instead of explicit declaration.
Combinational always block sensitivity list omits signals that are read inside (e.g., req_write, wmask, internal_ready, resp_ready), causing a mismatch.
